# Elana Tolliu: Russian editor and voice-over artist

> Freelance Russian-language editor and voice-over artist based near Gothenburg, Sweden (registered sole proprietor, enskild firma, approved for F-tax). Edits Russian manuscripts, machine-translated texts and AI-generated texts, and narrates e-learning, corporate training, instructional videos and documentaries in Russian.

## Services

- [Editing](https://elana.tolliu.pro/services/editing/): Russian editing of manuscripts, post-editing of machine translation and editing of AI-generated text. Request a quote by email.
- [Voice-over](https://elana.tolliu.pro/services/voice-over/): native Russian narration with demos, delivered as WAV 48 kHz / 24-bit from her own studio.
